rules.statement: A trust may be created for any lawful purpose, and the unlawful purposes that would forbid a trust being created are specifically referred to in section 4(1) of the Trusts Ordinance.
rules.supporting_quote: Section 4(1) of the Trusts Ordinance as stated earlier clearly refers to the fact that a trust may be created for any lawful purpose. The unlawful purposes, which would forbid a Trust being created, are specifically referred to in section 4(1).
